exposure: vesico-uterine space without chemical shift line
bladder wall interruption with hyperintense nodularity
cohort: 167 women with surgically confirmed severe placenta accreta spectrum (increta or percreta) who underwent planned cesarean delivery and had available placental MRI.
finding: Vesico-uterine space hypervascularity, vesico-uterine space without chemical shift line, and uterine-placental bulge were independently associated with bladder injury during cesarean delivery in women with severe placenta accreta spectrum.
